intro: Follow the administrative procedure, and tell apart the entry requirements, the strict deadlines and the specific grounds for rejection.

palabras.consejo: Official announcement of public grants or posts.
Adjective meaning the calendar year, from January to December.
Relating to public bodies or administrations.

texto: Per partecipare al bando comunale di sostegno agli affitti, compila il modulo online entro il 30 settembre e allega un documento d'identità valido, l'attestazione ISEE e la copia dell'ultimo contratto di locazione registrato presso l'Agenzia delle Entrate. Le domande incomplete o inviate con canali diversi dalla piattaforma informatica saranno automaticamente respinte senza possibilità di integrazione successiva. Il sistema invia una conferma via posta elettronica con un numero di protocollo, che servirà per verificare la propria posizione nella graduatoria provvisoria pubblicata a novembre. Chi ha già beneficiato di un contributo analogo nello stesso anno solare non può presentare una nuova richiesta. In caso di dubbi sulla documentazione da allegare, è possibile consultare le risposte alle domande frequenti sul portale istituzionale prima dell'invio definitivo.

frases.estudio: Per partecipare al bando comunale, compila il modulo online entro il trenta settembre.
frases.alumno: To take part in the municipal call, fill in the online form before the thirtieth of September.

frases.estudio: Le domande incomplete o inviate con canali diversi dalla piattaforma saranno automaticamente respinte.
frases.alumno: Incomplete applications, or applications sent through channels other than the platform, will be automatically rejected.

frases.estudio: Il sistema invia una ricevuta con il numero di protocollo per consultare la graduatoria.
frases.alumno: The system sends a receipt with the reference number so you can check the list of successful applicants.

frases.estudio: Chi ha già ricevuto un contributo nello stesso anno non può presentare richiesta.
frases.alumno: Anyone who has already received a grant in the same year cannot submit an application.

piezas.titulo: Vocabulary: public applications and calls for applications

pregunta.texto: What is the only accepted way to send the rent-support application?

opciones.texto: The official online platform, before 30 September.
opciones.explicacion: The text expressly requires the online form within that deadline.

opciones.texto: Handing it in person at the town hall's registry counter.
opciones.explicacion: Channels other than the official platform are expressly excluded.

opciones.texto: Sending a normal text message to the emergency number.
opciones.explicacion: The call excludes any informal, non-online channel.

frase.texto: Le domande inviate fuori termine saranno automaticamente ___.

opciones.explicacion: Feminine plural participle agreeing with «le domande».
It would mean accepted, which contradicts the terms of the call.
A late application cannot be renewed.

pregunta.texto: Why is it essential to keep the reference number (protocollo) received by email?

opciones.texto: To check and verify your position on the November list of successful applicants.
opciones.explicacion: The text makes clear that this code identifies the applicant in the ranking.

opciones.texto: To get free access to public transport across the whole province.
opciones.explicacion: It has nothing to do with help with paying rent.

opciones.texto: To avoid paying household electricity and water bills for a year.
opciones.explicacion: An interpretation with no documentary basis.

pregunta.texto: Which obstacle strictly rules out a person from submitting a new application?

opciones.texto: Having received a similar grant in the same calendar year.
opciones.explicacion: «Chi ha già beneficiato di un contributo analogo nello stesso anno solare non può».

opciones.texto: Not having a smartphone with a permanent internet connection.
opciones.explicacion: The application can be made from any computer or device.

opciones.texto: Having rented a home built before the last century.
opciones.explicacion: The age of the building is not one of the conditions for rejection.

frase.texto: Compila il modulo online entro settembre

piezas.traduccion: Fill in the online form before September
piezas.explicacion: Put the application instruction in order.

pregunta.texto: What prior formality must the lease have completed in order to be valid?

opciones.texto: Be properly registered with the tax authority.
Be signed in the presence of three members of the residents' board as witnesses.
opciones.explicacion: No witness appearance before neighbours is required.

opciones.texto: Have an unbroken history of more than five years.
opciones.explicacion: No restrictive time requirement is set for the contract.
